patterns: APPSC asks direct single-fact items: NMP target year (25% by 2022), Make in India launch date, logo (lion), BRAP expansion and AP's rank.
EoDB reform questions use an 'odd-one-out' trap: GST is a reform; removal of all foreign ownership limits, nationalisation, PSU expansion are not.
Strong AP tilt: AP No.1 in BRAP, first NIMZ in AP, ACI EoDB ranking with AP on top.
Other PSCs repeat: NMP year (Nov 2011), NMP objectives (12-14% growth, 100 million jobs by 2022 not 2025), DPIIT releases state EoDB ranking, India 2nd in mobile manufacturing.
App MCQs lean heavily on 2025-26 scheme figures (MPMS, ECMS, DESH, NITI index) and multi-statement formats, deeper than APPSC's simple recall pattern.
